items.title: Daily nicotine vaping in young never-smokers linked to impaired vascular function and lower fitness (JAMA Cardiology)
items.summary: In a small UK cross-sectional study of 58 healthy young adults, daily nicotine vape users had lower endothelial function and peak VO2 than never-users; cigarette smokers also had lower endothelial function (JAMA Cardiology, Oct 21, 2026).
bullets: **JAMA Cardiology** cross-sectional lab study: **daily nicotine vaping** in young adults who had **never smoked**.
**58 adults** (mean age 26; 52% female): **17 vape-only**, **19 cigarette smokers**, **22 naive**; no known CVD or major risk factors.
**Peak oxygen uptake** was **lower in vapers than naive** adults; minute ventilation and cardiac output were lower in **both nicotine groups**.
**Lung function and physical activity** did not differ between groups.
Caveats: **small, single-centre, cross-sectional**; shows association, not long-term clinical harm.
items.source: Boidin M, et al. JAMA Cardiology, Oct 21, 2026. doi:10.1001/jamacardio.2026.4626
